newsitem.title: KENYA: Opposition leader meets Kenyan president.
newsitem.headline: Opposition leader meets Kenyan president.

text.p: Opposition leader in parliament Michael Wamalwa met Kenya's President Daniel arap Moi on Wednesday to discuss the issue of constitutional reforms, aides said.

Wamalwa's aides had no immediate details of his talks with Moi, who on Tuesday in a bid to defuse pressure for reforms in Kenya met religious leaders and agreed on the need for a review of the constitution.
The meeting comes a week after the worst political unrest, over demands for sweeping reforms, rocked the east African nation.
The FORD-Kenya member of parliament, who heads the opposition, called a news conference shortly after his talks with the president.
In his first meeting with religious leaders on reforms since an opposition-backed campaign took to the streets of Nairobi in June, Moi and the clerics on Tuesday called for an end to violence.
